name: Tornado
doc: Tornado (the spell): the root and one director an action - the crater's pieces and the ground redrawn, the funnel's rings, the sparks, the morph cloud, the targets lifted and the debris bursts, the screen flash and shake, the sounds; the damage. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag146_tornado.cpp) run on the program's memory (its pools and packet arenas in the module).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Director
parts.doc: One director an action: the crater's pieces and the ground redrawn, the funnel's rings, the sparks, the morph cloud, the targets lifted and the debris bursts, the screen flash and shake, the sounds; the damage

params.label: Damage tick
params.doc: The damage at this tick of an action's director

params.label: Spark
params.doc: The sprite sequence spark (a flipbook of 16 frames: an edited one keeps as many)

params.label: Crater model
params.doc: The prim model crater (a mesh of 142 vertices, 261 primitives: an edited one keeps its vertices (its code reads them by number))

params.label: Texture file
params.doc: The texture file its loader reads from the magic folder (a name of at most 31 letters)

params.label: Camera track
params.doc: The camera track its setup plays (any length: its offsets are its own)

params.label: Cloud model
params.doc: The cloud's prim model (120 vertices: its vertices are where the morph starts; an edited one keeps them by number)

params.label: Cloud morph to
params.doc: The vertices the cloud blends to over 12 ticks (120 vertices x, y, z, pad: an edited one keeps the count)

not_editable.label: Funnel matrix
not_editable.doc: Identity; its translation 0xDD674C = the effect position
